basic_profile.bio: I'm a second-year undergrad student at McGill University, majoring in Computer Science. I'm originally from Toronto, and I moved to Montreal for my studies. My interests include coding, 3D modeling, and tinkering with old cars. In my free time, I enjoy playing video games and exploring Montreal's vibrant food scene. I'm usually online in the evenings after my classes and work shifts. I work part-time at a local café to support myself financially. I'm currently single and focused on my studies and self-improvement.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science, mainly through my coursework and personal projects. I also have a keen interest in 3D design, which I picked up through self-teaching and online tutorials. Additionally, I have a basic understanding of automotive mechanics, thanks to my family's interest in restoring vintage cars.
